description:
CLMCE, hosted at the University of Glasgow with European partners, studies children's literature, media and cultural mediation for careers in publishing, libraries and cultural institutions. Recent application rounds have used a mid-January scholarship deadline; the live dates are posted on the Glasgow programme page.

Programme Highlights

  • Glasgow-led programme with deep publishing-sector connections
  • Mobility across European partner universities
  • Mid-January scholarship deadline pattern in recent cycles
  • Graduates work in children's publishing, media, libraries and research

Who Should Apply

Literature, education, media and cultural-studies graduates with an interest in children's media ecosystems are the core applicants.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: tuition coverage plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the CLMCE page on the University of Glasgow site for the current round's dates and apply through the university's postgraduate portal. Key deadline information: Annual round — recent cycles used a mid-January scholarship deadline; confirm on the Glasgow programme page.
